findings.text: the sentence says the base module path is named on the log headers, but the committed base log it cites names /tmp/fenced-resume-base-1429673 while the sentence gives /tmp/fenced-resume-base-1405962, so a reader following the named path cannot check the arm the sentence vouches for.

the placed record's prefix carries no bare `--`, so the fence-relative separator search at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5319 is distinguished by no test: a regression to a whole-argv `argv.index("--")` passes here and would only fail once a placement declares a `--` ahead of the fence, which is the input the docstring names as the reason for the design.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 18a89e6f; the change adds `_names_the_fence`, `_harness_behind_the_fence` and the refusal inside `_backend_settings`, with the four-property test file, the composed-argv receipts and the plan's own section, all inside the declared write paths.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks the resume of a fenced run to reach its harness; the manifest's tests line carries the focused run (4 passed) and the two-arm gate (base 18a89e6f "6 failed, 114 passed" against head 49ecff80 "6 failed, 118 passed", identical failure ids), and I re-ran the named test file myself at the reviewed head and read both committed logs.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that `crew resume` of a fenced run reaches its harness instead of the fence; at head 8275aab1 the recorded command field that names the fence is refused (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5362) and the composed argv's element behind the fence element supplies the harness (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5369), and my own re-run of the node's test file at head returned 4 passed with exit 0.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; the reviewed run's manifest reads complete with commits 49ecff80 and 8275aab1, changed_paths matching the diff exactly, a tests line naming the focused run, and a negative_control_log whose first line matches the declared mutation verbatim.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared write paths; `git diff --name-only 18a89e6f..8275aab1` lists exactly the ten declared files, every one inside the fence the node was given.

justifications.durability: the main defect is encoded as an assertion that reddens at base (the fenced-clive resume composes two fence elements there) and the declared mutation ships as a test, while the fence-relative separator search the docstring justifies is pinned by no test.
justifications.evidence: the two-arm gate with identical failure ids, the before/after repro logs and the negative control whose first line matches the declared mutation verbatim are all committed, but one sentence in the landed record cites a base scratch module path that the committed base log it invokes does not name.
justifications.fit: the added lines carry no plan labels, ticket references or attribution, both commits use conventional subjects with bodies, and the refusal reuses the existing fence-binary identity rather than inventing a second spelling of it.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the repaired composition is proved at the level it was built — the composed argv and the resumed argv both name the harness — while the live resumed turn the plan's own falsifier wants stays owed, which the node's manifest records rather than hides.
justifications.scope_discipline: ten files in the diff, every one inside the node's declared write paths, with the plan's own section and evidence anchor carrying the landing record and the reviewed worktree clean at head.
